next.reason: 1985 says a one-value series, or variable-occurrence items totalling one occurrence, returns zero. 2023 defines the value as '(FUNCTION SQRT (FUNCTION VARIANCE (argument-list)))' (§2023:15.86.4 RV1). VARIANCE gives '(0)' 'For one occurrence of argument-1' (§2023:15.98.4 RV1), and the square root of zero is zero. ALL subscripts over variable-occurrence tables expand to one argument per occurrence (§2023:15.3, an uncatalogued paragraph), so a total of one occurrence is the same one-argument case. A one-value series still returns zero.
